top_signals.title: Taiwan Mulls Lowering Margin Requirement to Support Stock Market
top_signals.summary: Taiwan is considering lowering the margin requirement ratio for stock investors using borrowed funds as it tries to stem a selloff after the benchmark equity index’s worst week in 35 years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
